_: THE SEEDS. docs/PINS.md, docs/WELCOME.md §2. One pin Tari leaves in a room so its deck opens holding something. Signed Tari, spotless, level-less, replyable. Kacey's copy to redline — this is the app speaking in its own name and every line should sound like him, not like a generator.
stormwind-city: You can fish the canals. Most people have run past them a thousand times and never once cast.
ironforge: There is a museum in the Hall of Explorers and a plaque under everything in it. Nobody reads them.
orgrimmar: Thrall is upstairs in Grommash Hold and will be there all expansion. Worth walking up once while he still is.
darnassus: Almost nobody enters the Temple of the Moon unless a quest sends them. Go in and look up.
thunder-bluff: The lifts are slow. Ride one facing out.
undercity: The ring is one loop and every quarter hangs off it. Walk it once without opening the map.
elwynn-forest: You will out-level this in a weekend and never come back. Take one lap first.
dun-morogh: It snows the entire time you are here and nobody ever mentions it.
durotar: Red rock, no shade, and a coastline most people never see.
mulgore: The most peaceful zone in the game, and the one people leave fastest.
teldrassil: You are inside a tree. It stops being obvious after an hour, so notice it in the first one.
tirisfal-glades: The sky here is a colour that exists nowhere else in the game.
darkshore: The coast is the zone. Walk the shoreline instead of the road, once.
loch-modan: The dam is the landmark. The loch is the zone. Fish it.
silverpine-forest: Everything is grey on purpose. Turn the music up.
westfall: Sit through one sunset here. It costs nothing and it is the best in the game.
the-barrens: Everybody remembers the chat and nobody remembers the zone. Ride it end to end once with the sound on.
redridge-mountains: Stand on the bridge once and look at where you are. Then go back to killing gnolls.
stonetalon-mountains: There is a peak at the top of this zone with half of Kalimdor under it.
ashenvale: It is enormous and almost nobody walks the north half.
duskwood: The fog never lifts and it never gets brighter. Somebody chose that.
hillsbrad-foothills: Southshore and Tarren Mill are twenty seconds apart. That is the entire story of this zone.
wetlands: Everyone sprints the road because of the raptors. Walk it once instead.
thousand-needles: The mesas are the point. Look up rather than forward.
alterac-mountains: Barely anybody quests here, which is a reason to come rather than a reason to skip it.
arathi-highlands: Open, windy and mostly empty. Bring a fishing pole.
desolace: It is named honestly. Come anyway, once.
ragefire-chasm: Twenty minutes, directly under Orgrimmar, and most players never set foot in it.
the-deadmines: The ship at the end is a real ship. People kill Cookie and leave without ever looking up at it.
wailing-caverns: Everybody gets lost in here. Getting lost is most of it.
shadowfang-keep: Do not pull the courtyard from the ramp.
blackfathom-deeps: Half of it is underwater, and the underwater half is the reason to come.
razorfen-kraul: A maze made out of thorns. The wrong turns are the good part.
the-stockade: It is under the Stormwind canals, it takes fifteen minutes, and most players never go in.
gnomeregan: Everybody hates it. Do it once anyway, slowly, and read the names on the machines.
